issue.title: Valid issue-refinement task packet fixture
issue.body:
## Required Task Fields

```yaml
lane: validation_tooling
intelligence_level: frontier
reason: "Fixture supports task-packet non-expansion checks."
durable_source_of_truth: "GitHub issue #1001"
objective: "Validate task-packet narrowing."
plan:
  - compare packet with issue
checklist:
  - command passes
acceptance_sheet:
  - packet stays within issue
allowed_paths:
  - scripts/asgk.py
  - docs/control/TASK_PACKET_FORMAT.md
expected_output:
  - task packet check JSON
non_goals:
  - no compact governance default
stop_conditions:
  - packet expands authority
rollback_expectations:
  - revert fixture
context_read_set:
  - AGENTS.md
  - scripts/asgk.py
  - docs/control/TASK_PACKET_FORMAT.md
project_specific_validation:
  - python3 scripts/asgk.py task-packet-check
  - python3 scripts/asgk.py doctor
```
